text:
Raj (AcmeApp): hey @support — our rerank calls started returning a lot of 5xx/504s during a traffic ramp this morning. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~2.3s, and we see gateway timeouts and retries spiking. sample request_id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can you help triage?

Alice (Support): sorry for the trouble, Raj. can you paste a minimal repro (curl + payload) and the approximate request rate (rps) and concurrency you were hitting? any recent client changes?

Raj (AcmeApp): here's the curl we've been using (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"best features for product search","candidates":["...", "..." /* ~500 items */], "max_candidates":500, "top_k":5}'
```

Traffic: ~40 rps from our fleet during the ramp, each request does 4 parallel clients (so ~160 concurrent requests). Our client retries on 502/504 with 3 retries (exp backoff). We started seeing 502/504s around 09:42 UTC.

Ben (Eng Runtime): thanks — two quick checks: 1) what's the average token length per candidate / total token count? 2) are you using the hosted tier or dedicated? big candidate lists + long sequences can blow up runtime work and cause queueing.

Raj (AcmeApp): avg candidate ~ 35 tokens, but there are outliers up to 600 tokens (some product descriptions). average total tokens per request ~ 12000. We're on hosted.

Carmen (SRE): copying some immediate checks we do: looking for gateway logs for req_0a1b2c3d and runtime worker logs. Raj, can you share one of the backend response traces (X-Request-ID header or full gateway log line)? also does your client send `Connection: keep-alive`?

Raj (AcmeApp): pasted a gateway snippet we captured (redacted):

```
[09:43:17] nginx  -  client: 10.4.5.6 "POST /v1/rerank" 502  - "-" "req_0a1b2c3d" upstream_response_time: 9.988, request_time: 10.015
[09:43:17] runtime-01 ERROR  ctx=req_0a1b2c3d handler=rerank: context deadline exceeded while waiting for worker
[09:43:17] runtime-01 WARN   worker-pool: all workers busy=64 queued=123
[09:43:18] runtime-02 ERROR  oom in kv-cache shard 3: evict failed
```

Alice (Support): that upstream_response_time ~9.99s is telling — gateway timed out waiting for the runtime. Our default gateway timeout is 10s. The runtime appears to be overloaded and returning context timeouts rather than graceful 4xx errors.

Ben (Eng Runtime): root cause hypothesis: large candidate counts combined with long sequences are taking too long to score, and the retry behavior + concurrency created a feedback loop. routing/gateway hits its 10s timeout -> retries -> more load -> worker pool exhaustion -> 502/504.

Carmen (SRE): immediate mitigations you can try now (Raj) to stabilize: 1) reduce `max_candidates` to <= 200, 2) turn off client retries (or add jitter + longer backoff), 3) limit client-side concurrency to <= 20 concurrent requests, 4) if possible, trim candidate length (truncate descriptions) or pre-filter using a cheap embedding similarity as a first pass. We'll also add a temporary rate limit at the gateway for your org until we have a better fix.

Raj (AcmeApp): will try lowering max_candidates now and stop retries. one question: do you have a recommended server-side setting so we don't have to throttle aggressively?

Ben (Eng Runtime): medium-term fixes on our side: 1) validate and return 4xx for candidate_count > 300 to avoid silent overload, 2) add a per-request token quota check and fail fast if estimated compute > threshold, 3) add adaptive queue shedding (reject low-priority heavy requests under pressure). We can sketch a small hotfix to start rejecting excessive requests with a clear error.

DeployBot: deployment queued: runtime-hotfix/limit-heavy-rerank -> staging, CI green. estimated deploy start: in 12m.

Carmen (SRE): another protective action: bump the gateway proxy timeout temporarily to 20s only as a band-aid while we roll hotfixes, but that increases tail latency and may worsen worker pile-up — only do this if you can throttle request rate.

Raj (AcmeApp): applying changes now: set max_candidates=150 and stopped retries. also added a client-side truncate rule for descriptions > 200 tokens. will report back in 10m.

(10m later)

Raj (AcmeApp): update: after reducing candidates to 150 and killing retries, p95 dropped to ~160ms and we stopped seeing 502/504s. traffic same ~40 rps. thanks.

Alice (Support): great to hear. we'll keep the temporary gateway rate limit for an hour and monitor. Raj, want us to open a support credit case for the extra token usage from retry storms?

Raj (AcmeApp): yes please — retries caused a lot of duplicate work, would appreciate a credit.

Maya (Product): action items for us: 1) publish a KB article recommending `max_candidates` guardrails and client retry best practices for rerank, 2) update hosted defaults to include a soft cap and clear 4xx message when exceeded, 3) follow up with product/eng on offering a `fast_pre-filter` option (cheap embedding filter) as a first-class feature.

Ben (Eng Runtime): I'll open a PR to enforce candidate_count limit + token-estimator with a nice error payload (400 with code `excessive_candidate_count`) and add telemetry for these rejections. Link will be posted.

Carmen (SRE): and I'll create a postmortem stub in #postmortems with timeline and mitigation steps. also recommend we add an alert for worker-pool queued > 100 to catch this earlier.

Alice (Support): tagging this as SEV-3 for now. Raj, forwarding the recommended config changes and we'll keep monitoring for 2 hours. feel free to DM if you see regressions. :thumbsup:

Raj (AcmeApp): thanks everyone. appreciate the quick help — we'll plan to test the hotfix once it's deployed and report any oddities.

(20m later)

DeployBot: runtime-hotfix/limit-heavy-rerank deployed to production: sha=deafbeef commit=fix/rerank-guardrails.

Ben (Eng Runtime): hotfix live. added server-side check: requests with estimated_token_work > 50k now return 400 with body: {"error": "excessive_compute_estimate", "details": "reduce candidates or shorten inputs"}. telemetry shows ~0.8% of requests rejected at peak — good to avoid cascade.

Carmen (SRE): monitoring looks stable. p95 for rerank back in normal range, 5xxs dropped to baseline. I'll coordinate on the postmortem and the KB.

Maya (Product): will draft KB and a short note to customers about best practices for rerank usage and retry/backoff guidance.

Alice (Support): closing the escalation once Raj confirms no further problems in 2 hours. thanks all. :pray:

Raj (AcmeApp): thanks everyone. appreciate the quick help — we'll plan to test the hotfix once it's deployed and report any oddities.
